2027 Summer Internship Program - APAC

Asia Pacific
Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, Taiwan
Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei, Tokyo
2027
Summer Internship Program

Our summer internship is open to students one year away from finishing an undergraduate or postgraduate degree, graduating between autumn 2026 and summer 2028.

The programme gives students a demanding but supportive taste of life as a full-time analyst, with real work, training and people who want them to succeed.

After an orientation week, interns learn on the job, take on daily responsibilities in their teams, and join talks, mentoring and networking events over the summer.

Interns who enjoy the summer can go on to apply for the full-time analyst programme afterwards.

Important:
You may apply to one programme only, and to at most two business functions within it.
A withdrawn application cannot be resubmitted for this programme in the same year.

Next steps:
After applying you will be sent an online assessment, which must be completed within five days or the application lapses.

Application deadlines:
Hong Kong: Applications closed on 20 September 2026 (23:55 local time).

Note:

  • Applications for Human Resources to be closed on 4 October 2026 (23:55 local time).


Singapore: Applications closed on 20 September 2026 (23:55 local time).

Note:

  • Applications for Human Resources to be closed on 4 October 2026 (23:55 local time).
  • Applications for Aladdin Data to be closed on 25 October 2026 (23:55 local time).


Tokyo: Applications are now open. As we recruit on a rolling basis, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
